newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM sees no change in China after Deng death.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM sees no change in China after Deng death.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto told U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright on Monday that he expects no major change in China after the death of paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.

A Japanese Foreign Ministry official told reporters that Hashimoto, who met Albright over breakfast before she left for Beijing, said Deng's death had been "factored in" and that he saw no major change in China.
On Sunday, Japanese Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda also told Albright that he saw no signs of "confusion" developing in China after Deng's death.
Albright and Hashimoto agreed it was important for both the United States and Japan to build a "constructive" relationship with China, the ministry official said.
Albright arrived in Tokyo on Sunday from Seoul as part of a nine-nation tour, her first overseas trip since becoming secretary of state last month.
Albright left on Monday for Beijing, her last destination before returning to Washington.
